2610.07426.title: AccentCL: Robust Accent Classification with Incremental Expansion
2610.07426.paper_summary: Accent classifiers are typically trained with a fixed label inventory and cannot accommodate new accent categories as new data becomes available. Moreover, accented speech corpora often exhibit substantial class imbalance and/or domain shift due to differences in recording conditions across corpora. We present AccentCL, a class-incremental learning framework for English accent classification that is robust to class imbalance and cross-corpus domain shift. AccentCL extracts multi-layer representations from a frozen Whisper-Large-v3 encoder, optimized with an imbalance-aware cross-entropy loss to reduce bias toward the majority accent classes and a domain mean alignment loss that minimizes distributional mean shift across training corpora. The label space is then expanded via replay-based continual learning, using the frozen base model for knowledge retention and an old-to-new margin loss to reduce overprediction on newly added classes. On a five-class accent classification task, AccentCL achieves 77.1% balanced accuracy and a 76.9% macro-averaged F1 score. We further evaluate the model's ability to incrementally incorporate two new accent categories: Spanish-accented and Chinese-accented English. When adding Spanish-accented English to the pretrained model, AccentCL attains an F1 of 83.3% on the new class while retaining 77.3% balanced accuracy on the base classes. When subsequently adding Chinese-accented English, it achieves 61.8% F1 on the new class while preserving 77.6% balanced accuracy on the previously learned classes. These results show that AccentCL enables robust regional accent classification while allowing new accent categories to be added without full retraining.
2610.07426.paper_summary_zh: 口音分類器通常使用固定的標籤庫進行訓練，無法隨著新數據的出現而適應新的口音類別。此外，由於不同語料庫之間錄音條件的差異，帶口音的語音語料庫通常會出現顯著的類別不平衡和/或領域轉移。我們提出了 AccentCL，一種對類別不平衡和跨語料庫領域轉移具有魯棒性的英語口音分類的類別增量學習框架。AccentCL 從一個凍結的 Whisper-Large-v3 編碼器中提取多層表示，並使用一種考慮不平衡的交叉熵損失進行優化，以減少對主要口音類別的偏見，並使用一種領域均值對齊損失來最小化訓練語料庫之間的分佈均值轉移。然後，通過基於重播的持續學習擴展標籤空間，使用凍結的基礎模型進行知識保留，並使用舊到新邊際損失來減少對新添加類別的過度預測。在一個五類口音分類任務中，AccentCL 實現了 77.1% 的平衡準確率和 76.9% 的宏觀平均 F1 分數。我們進一步評估模型逐步納入兩個新口音類別的能力：西班牙口音和中文口音的英語。在將西班牙口音的英語添加到預訓練模型時，AccentCL 在新類別上達到了 83.3% 的 F1，同時在基礎類別上保持了 77.3% 的平衡準確率。隨後添加中文口音的英語時，它在新類別上達到了 61.8% 的 F1，同時在之前學習的類別上保持了 77.6% 的平衡準確率。這些結果表明，AccentCL 能夠實現穩健的區域口音分類，同時允許在不進行全面重新訓練的情況下添加新的口音類別。
